features:
**PREMIUM FEATURES**


**--- Automation ---**

• Auto Forge - Perfect Minigame + High Quality

• Auto Sell – Sells inventory automatically at set intervals

• Auto Target Rock – Mining Rock Only (Volcanic Rock, Basalt Core, etc)

- Auto Targe Ore - Mining Ore Only ( Darkryte, Demonite etc.)

- Auto Killing - Kill All Mobs/Enemies automatically

- Auto Defense - Kill the Attackers while mining (Mob/Enemies)

- Skip Mined Rock/Ore

• Auto Favorite – Favorites fish by rarity, name, or mutations


**--- Auto Purchase & Upgrades ---**

• Auto Buy Best – Buys best affordable equipment/pickaxe automatically

- Auto Buy Shop - Buy Weapon, Pickaxe, Potion automatically and anywhere

- Auto Sell Shop - Sell Weapon, Pickaxe automatically and anywhere

• Auto Enhance – Uses essence to enhance your weapon Max +9

**--- Utilities & Features ---**

- Desync/Godmode/Invisible - Automatically hide your position/character from people

• Save & Load Config – Easy to use, just save and load your current features setting

• Auto Rejoin – Rejoin when your account disconnect (public server)

• FPS Boost – Reduce lag and boost FPS by lowering text

• Player Tools – Anti-AFK, speed controls, etc

• Teleports – Instant travel to islands, NPCs, or players

• Server Hop – Switch servers by population
